DailyInsight.// AgentUrl: Optional — when set, posts to {AgentUrl}/insight (e.g. the Python/daily-insight service) instead of calling Anthropic + MCP inline. Leave empty/unset to use the inline path.
DailyInsight.// AgentBearerToken: Optional — when set, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> on every POST to {AgentUrl}/insight. Set this when the agent endpoint requires bearer authentication. Leave empty for an unauthenticated endpoint (e.g. local development).
